chung.Syllabus Name: Mobility Applications Design 2 _ Thiết kế ứng dụng cho các thiết bị di động 2
chung.Description: This course aims to provide student understanding on techniques, tools and skills to do a practical application design project. To study this course, student must have basic knowledge related to Interaction and UX Design, understanding principles and agile process applied in a mobile design project. In this course, student will perform a design project individually and have to work with programmer to transform an idea to a product. They will learn how to do from a research to design and implement an application project. They will learn about how to run a study of domain interested, how to make use-case list and draw flow diagram. They will be taught about the way to write a proposal for a project. In design phase, there are alot of things student must aware about, so they will be taught about them including rules, principles and good practices such as Realism, Fitts's Law, Animation, Speed and etc.. Testing techniques such as A/B Testing, Usability Testing will also be explained in this course. Student will be evaluated according to how his/her applied knowledge gained from this course to the course's project.

taiLieu: A Project Guide to UX Design - For User Experience Designers in the field or in the making
Design For Use - Create Usable Interfaces for Applications and the Web
Essential Mobile Interaction Design - Perfecting Interface Design in Mobile Apps
Interaction Design - Beyond Human Computer Interaction
Jenny Preece, Helen Sharp, Yvonne Rogers
clo: Discuss key aspects of mobile application design and development, including process stages, platform differences, and user interaction models.
Conduct domain-specific research to identify real user problems and develop a research-backed proposal for a mobile application solution.
Create sketches and paper prototypes to explore and communicate early-stage design ideas and user flows.
Build interactive digital prototypes using up-to-date design tools (e.g., Figma, ProtoPie, Framer, or similar), representing realistic app behavior.
Enhance design solutions by applying UI/UX principles, mobile-specific best practices, and visual design guidelines.
Explain and apply evaluation methods in the implementation phase, including usability testing, A/B testing, and remote testing techniques.
Conduct usability testing on mobile prototypes, gather feedback, and derive actionable insights to improve the product.
Manage project tasks collaboratively throughout the full mobile app design process, including coordination with developers and team members.
Present the design process and outcome effectively through well-structured documentation, visual storytelling presentations.
